description: Agent Support Operations: submit the support summary written for the principal with the records beneath it: the summary with its reference, period, who it is written for, the unresolved tickets, broken promises, escalation failures and commitment misses it discloses as counts and the satisfaction figure it states as a percent; the records with each ticket and its status, each promise record and whether it was kept, each escalation record and whether it failed, each commitment miss and each customer rating with whether the customer was satisfied. The signed report gives the summary and the records, each category the records hold against its disclosure, each count the summary states against the count the records hold, and the satisfaction figure against the ratings, and counts them, and names a divergent support summary: unresolved tickets, broken promises, escalation failures or commitment misses the records hold and the summary leaves out, a count the summary states below the records, and a satisfaction figure more than one point above what the ratings give, smoothing the record into a figure the records underneath do not bear out; then a count stated above the records and a satisfaction figure resting on fewer than ten ratings, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No records, no counts and no satisfaction figure, or a satisfaction figure with no ratings supplied leaves those points unverified. Open and pending tickets count as unresolved, promises marked unkept as broken, escalations marked failed as failures and each listed miss as a commitment miss, and the satisfaction figure is recomputed to the tenth of a point from the satisfied ratings. This reads whether the support summary discloses what the records hold, with its counts. Verdict support_report_divergent, support_report_partial, support_report_unverified or support_report_consistent. POST /api/support-report-check. Reads the support records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it answers no customer, sends no message and opens, closes or changes no ticket, which stay with the support team, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Support Operations reads support operation records: ticket logs, first response records, resolution records, escalation records, promise records, performance records, backlog records and the support summary, each against the queue record, the stated response commitments, the customer confirmations, the stated escalation triggers, what the records show happened, the stated service commitments, the ticket list or the records beneath it. The family’s ground is support work already done, read across the whole queue: the DiligenceOps support brief reads one support conversation and lists the promises made in it, and the Agent Feedback family reads the loop around feedback on work, while this family checks whether the support operation’s records hold together across tickets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-support-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-support-operations/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

escalations.description: Each escalation record in the period.

failed.description: Whether the escalation failed: not raised, not acted on or raised too late.

misses.description: Each commitment miss in the period.

promises.description: Each promise record in the period.

kept.description: Whether the record shows the promise kept.

ratings.description: Each customer rating in the period.

satisfied.description: Whether the customer rated the support satisfied.

status.description: The ticket status: open, pending, solved or closed.

broken_promises.description: The broken promises the summary discloses.

commitment_misses.description: The commitment misses the summary discloses.

escalation_failures.description: The escalation failures the summary discloses.

period.description: The reporting period, such as 2026-03 or 2026-Q1.

satisfaction_percent.description: The satisfaction figure the summary states, as a percent.

unresolved.description: The unresolved tickets the summary discloses.

written_for.description: Who the summary is written for.

name: wever_support-report-check
title: Support report check
